trends.name: Iran Oil Crisis & Strait of Hormuz
trends.summary: Trump threatens military action against Iran's oil infrastructure and Kharg Island; Hormuz Strait traffic near standstill; oil prices surge toward $200/barrel with $115+ Brent crude. Iran retaliating with attacks on regional infrastructure including aluminum producers and desalination plants in Kuwait, creating commodity shocks across metals and energy markets.

trends.name: Recession Probability Surging to 40%
trends.summary: Prediction markets now pricing 40% recession odds for 2026—sharp climb from recent weeks. Oil spike fueling inflation fears and overshadowing Powell's dovish messaging on rate cuts. Combines geopolitical shock with macro uncertainty as growth risks mount.

trends.name: Fed Rate Cut Outlook vs Oil-Driven Inflation
trends.summary: Powell signals inflation in check with no rate hikes needed for oil shock, but markets are pricing higher odds of Fed hikes as oil surges. Goldman Sachs warns markets are misreading Fed policy—investors overestimating hawkish pivot despite inflation concerns from energy prices. Critical disconnect between Fed guidance and market expectations.

trends.name: Tech IPO Index Additions (SpaceX, OpenAI)
trends.summary: Nasdaq paving the way for SpaceX and OpenAI to quickly join premier indices post-IPO. Signals massive capital inflows to AI and space sectors; reflects continued investor appetite for high-growth mega-cap tech despite broader market volatility and recession concerns.

trends.name: Meta Stock Rally & 45% Upside Call
trends.summary: Morgan Stanley upgrades Meta with 45% upside target; analyst waiting for $450 entry. Reflects positioning in mega-cap tech as defensive/growth play amid macro uncertainty. Part of broader institutional rotation into profitable AI-exposed names.

trends.name: Oil & Commodity Surge (Gold, Silver, Aluminum)
trends.summary: Silver at massive buying opportunity post-selloff; gold names like Newmont favored as geopolitical hedge. Iran's attacks on aluminum producers sending shockwaves through metals complex. Oil-driven rally creates inflationary backdrop pressuring bonds and equities simultaneously.

trends.name: Bitcoin Strategy Pauses Purchases First Time
trends.summary: Institutional strategy skips a week of bitcoin purchases for the first time in 2026—signals potential caution or tactical repositioning amid macro uncertainty and recession concerns. Possible leading indicator for risk-off sentiment among sophisticated crypto investors.

trends.name: Sysco $29B Restaurant Depot Acquisition
trends.summary: Sysco nearing deal to acquire Restaurant Depot for ~$29B, betting on cash-and-carry food service model. Major consolidation play in food distribution amid post-pandemic normalization; reflects M&A activity despite macro headwinds and housing market challenges.

trends.name: 401(k) Oversight Rules & Alternative Assets
trends.summary: Labor Department proposing major changes to 401(k) plan oversight; alternative asset rule expansion signals regulatory shift toward private equity and hedge fund access for retail investors. Potential structural shift in retirement capital allocation and institutional flows.

trends.name: Streaming & Media Subscriber Growth Stalling
trends.summary: Despite subscriber growth, spending on streaming services has stalled—signals margin pressure and pricing power limits for media companies. Relevant to Meta, Disney, and content-focused platforms as cord-cutting maturity pressures revenue growth.

trends.name: Utility Stocks as Iran War Hedge
trends.summary: Utility stocks offer defensive safety during Iran conflict but haven't rallied since war outbreak. Investors reconsidering inflation hedges and safe havens; signals rotation from tech into stable dividend payers despite rate cut expectations.

trends.name: Venezuela Embassy Reopening & Geopolitical Thaw
trends.summary: US Embassy in Venezuela formally resuming operations Monday—signals potential diplomatic normalization with Maduro regime. Macro backdrop of US geostrategic reengagement; could affect energy supply assumptions and Latin American equities outlook.
